title: Graphics and geometric thinking with turtle

spans.text: WHY USE THIS?
Turtle teaches geometry and loops visually; coordinates and turn angles are immediately visible.
CORE EXPLANATION

The virtual turtle moves on a coordinate plane, raises or lowers its pen, and draws in color. It makes loops, functions, angles, coordinates, and state changes visible; it is a teaching tool, not a production game engine or high-performance 3D renderer. Put repeated movement into functions and parameterize the shape.
EXAMPLE CODE
QUESTION: What will this code print? Predict first, then run it.

spans.code:
import turtle

pen = turtle.Turtle()
for _ in range(4):
    pen.forward(80)
    pen.right(90)
turtle.done()

spans.text: EXPECTED RESULT

spans.code: A square is drawn in a graphics window; no console text is printed.

spans.title: Important tip
spans.text: Start with a simple shape, then parameterize its side count: a regular n-sided polygon turns by 360/n degrees per step.
